name: Monk Divine Ascetic
body:
A divine ascetic blends divine magic from their deity or faith into their martial arts.

Domain (Su)

At 1st level, a divine ascetic gains a domain available to their deity or faith. They gain the abilities from the domain at the levels a cleric would gain them. The spells from the domain are added to the divine ascetic’s spell list as noted below.

Spell Casting

At 4th level, a divine ascetic gains the ability to cast spells. They use the same spells per day as a paladin, though they may prepare any spell from the cleric spell list and the list provided by their domain. They use their Wisdom modifier for their spellcasting ability modifier. This ability replaces all instances of slow fall, the bonus feats at 6th and 14th levels, and quivering palm for the monk. For the unchained monk, this ability replaces the ki power gained at 4th, 10th, and 16th levels, the bonus feats at 6th and 14th levels and the style strike gained at 17th level.

Divine Strike (Su)

At 4th level, a divine ascetic can deliver melee touch spells as part of a full attack action.

At 8th level, they are also able to deliver ranged touch attacks as melee touch attacks during the full attack action.
